section:
### Additional comparison

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 7. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 163 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Blood pressure control | 181 | 450 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
